selection_basis: Actual MP4 RGB: B1 body visible in C1/C2 and painted tip contour clear in C3; identity checked with declared ideal B1 rigid pose. No truth geometry used.
source_scope: public span and coarse Table 3-1 chord/twist dimensions
approximation: rounded elliptical sections; 0.8 m tip endpoint prior; no exact NREL airfoil surface
control_parameter_role: B-spline control-polygon coefficients; control_z reports Greville abscissae
interpolation_scope: optimized centreline offsets and chord log-ratios; fixed template dimensions unchanged
initial_template_policy: identical public coarse initial template; smooth only optimized offsets and chord log-ratios
regularization_policy: unchanged original formulas on inverse-mapped reference-axis coefficients and ell
greville_extension: analytic cubic basis; fixed chord/twist linearly interpolated from original rings
constraint_policy: original open boxes after inverse map; coupled in Greville coordinates; no clamping
model_family_policy: original mesh basis and fixed-prior buffers copied exactly; no independent center spline
